messages:
sam: Quick q — should we enable automatic model-variant fallback when a primary model is saturated by default per-route? Thinking header-opt-out + console toggle so teams can opt into the behavior.

lina: +1 for header opt-out. default-on worries me because of cache affinity (KV cache warmness) and semantics differences between variants.

jordan: FWIW the runtime can detect saturation via backend signals (queue depth, slot util) and emit fallback_reason=saturation. We can gate by tenant tier and region.

ashley: Product concern: customers expect consistent outputs. Falling back to smaller/quantized variants may change quality. Need explicit UX: "may degrade quality" and a toggle in console with audit log.

mike: Technical note: some variants (q4_0) have incompatible KV cache format; switching breaks prefix caching and increases latency for first tokens. We should prefer compatible variants unless latency budget is exceeded.

sam: Good point. Proposal: per-route config with fields: auto_variant_fallback (bool), fallback_policy ("prefer_compatible" | "prefer_cost" | "prefer_latency"), fallback_order list, tenant_whitelist list. Example config: 
```json
{
  "auto_variant_fallback": true,
  "fallback_policy": "prefer_compatible",
  "fallback_order": ["model-A-8B-compat","model-A-8B-q4"],
  "max_extra_latency_ms": 200
}
```

lina: Love the policy options. Also add a sticky header to preserve affinity for a session: `X-Redwood-Fallback: sticky=true`. If sticky=false, we can route subsequent requests to the better variant.

jordan: Telemetry: emit events `fallback.probe` (when we test probe a variant), `fallback.trigger` (actual fallback), include metrics: primary_slot_pct, queue_ms, selected_variant, tenant_tier. Console should surface counts + error deltas.

devops-bot: NOTE: deploying router change to canary 10% on eng-prod at 2026-07-12T09:00Z.

ashley: Can we do a safety net: if quality-regression alerts spike after fallback, auto-revert rollout? tie to Redwood Optimize eval hooks.

mike: Yes — implement short-circuit: if evals/QA metric delta > threshold for N minutes, stop fallback and mark tenant for manual review. Also log a per-tenant "fallback_blocklist".

sam: Ops/console ask: what about quotas? fallback should respect tenant token quota and quota-by-variant cost implications. We should show projected cost delta in console before enabling.

console-bot: Feature flag `auto_variant_fallback_v1` enabled for orgs: beta-list. Console will show estimated cost impact and fidelity risk when toggling.

jordan: rollout plan suggestion: 1) default off globally, 2) enable per-route via API and console for internal teams, 3) canary 10% tenants for 2 weeks, 4) promote if no major regressions. Include telemetry dashboards and alert playbook.

sam: Sounds good. Action items: mike to add compatibility check + sticky header support; jordan to spec telemetry events and dashboard tiles; ashley to draft console UX wording and audit copy; lina to write short ops runbook. I'll own rollout coordination.

lina: thanks — I'll start a short doc with examples and add to runbook. :thumbsup:
